allow_instructions: Project-local npm/pnpm/yarn install, test, and build scripts.
Read-only git status and git diff.
Docker Compose for local Postgres and dev services only.
Bash or shell scripts inside this repository for dev/test.
block_instructions: Do not run git commit, git push, git push --force, or any deploy/release command without explicit user approval.
Do not read, cat, type, or open .env or other secret/credential files.
Do not run global package installs (npm i -g, pip install --user, etc.).
Do not connect to production databases or use production API keys.
